messages:
frank: Heads-up: several SEs reported that the "soft deprec" banner we shipped in the console is being clicked accidentally by tenants and immediately pinning them to v1. Can we make the UX less destructive?

lela: saw that too. current flow: Banner -> "Migrate" button -> modal with "Pin to v1" checkbox (checked by default). That's a bad default.

oscar: whoa default checked is a classic antipattern. Why was it like that?

mira: short story: product wanted an easy escape hatch during rollout. That checkbox was intended for power users and should never be pre-checked.

frank: immediate mitigation: flip default to unchecked and change button wording to "Open migration options" instead of "Migrate" so accidental clicks don't apply config.

lela: agree. Also add a small confirmation step if the user attempts to pin: modal should show estimated impact (approx forwarded QPS, v1 capacity margin) and require typing the tenant name to confirm.

oscar: runtime side: when someone pins, create an audit event AND a temporary auto-revert TTL of 7 days unless they explicitly extend. That prevents silent long-lived pins.

mira: telemetry ask: we need to capture click-through rate on the banner, count of accidental pins, and median time pinned. Add metrics: banner_clicks, pin_confirmations, pin_auto_reverts.

build-bot: deploy: console-banner-fix pushed to staging (job: cb-2026-03-21-42).

frank: bonus: surface a pre-check that shows "This tenant has >5% header-less traffic. Pinning may forward X TPS to v1". If estimated forwarding >10% of v1 pool, disable pin and show contact-SE CTA.

lela: UX microcopy: the banner should say: "v1 is deprecated; most clients should use v2. Click to view migration options. Pinning retains v1 for this tenant." Keep it short and avoid scary language.

oscar: on the API side, add a safe endpoint for console to preview the impact: /console/preview_pin?tenant=... returns a small JSON summary (we'll call it preview text, not machine-acted). Make sure the endpoint respects access control.

frank: product/billing note: pinned traffic should be billed with an annotation 'pinned_v1' so finance can reconcile if customers expect v1 pricing. Sam from billing will confirm specific invoice behavior.

mira: runtime guard: if pin would cause v1_fallback_rate > 7% sustained in a region, block and surface an "insufficient capacity" modal with an option to request temporary capacity increase (SE flow).

lela: I'll update the Figma mocks and add the confirmation pattern. We'll also show a tiny chart of headerless_ratio over the last 24h in the modal.

oscar: implementation owners: oscar(runtime pin + guard), lela(console + mocks), mira(telemetry + audit), frank(product + rollout comms). ETA: staged console UX fix tomorrow, full guard + preview endpoint by Friday.

mira: thumbs up. follow-ups: I'll open an RFC with thresholds and the audit schema. Closing this thread, please DM if you see urgent problems.
